findings.message: Schema validation failed; XML does not comply with UBL 2.1 standards in line with ZATCA specifications. ERROR: org.xml.sax.SAXParseException; lineNumber: 5; columnNumber: 44; cvc-datatype-valid.1.2.1: '0000-02-29' is not a valid value for 'date'.

[BR-KSA-98] - The simplified invoice should be submitted within 24 hours of issuing the invoice.
[BR-KSA-69]-A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) 'Zero rated' shall have a VAT exception reason code (BT-121).
